game.title: Kula Gaddu (Tops Game)
game.description: A traditional spinning top game where children carve wooden tops and compete in spinning duration and battling other tops.
howToPlay: Step 1: Children carve wooden tops from local wood or purchase them.
Step 2: Wind string around the top from bottom to top.
Step 3: Throw the top while pulling the string to make it spin.
Step 4: Compete to see whose top spins the longest.
Step 5: In battle mode, players try to knock opponents' tops out of a ring.
Step 6: Tops can be decorated with colors and patterns.
Step 7: Skilled players develop techniques for powerful spins.
Step 8: Tops that spin longest or knock out others win.
Step 9: Game develops hand-eye coordination and technique.
Step 10: Winners collect opponents' tops as prizes.
